newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade Office closes acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade Office closes acquisition.

text.p: Boise Cascade Office Products Corp said it has completed acquisition of OstermanAPI Inc, a promotional products company based in Maumee, Ohio with annual revenues of about $65 million.
Boise Cascade Office Products said it has formed a new company, Boise Marketing Services Inc, to include its existing promotional products company, OWNCO, and OstermanAPI.

Michael Osterman will become president of the new company and hold a minority equity position, as will John Garrity of Osterman. Curt Sheinen and Jim Mendenhall, officers of OWNCO, will also each have an equity interest in the new company.
Boise Cascade Office Products will initially own about 88 percent of Boise Marketing Services. Other terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

"This acquisition makes us one of the top three promotional products companies in the U.S. with annual sales of approximately $100 million," said Pete Danis, Boise Cascade Office Products president, in a statement.
"The formation of Boise Marketing Services will help us grow aggressively in this area and take advantage of opportunities in the marketplace as further consolidation occurs," he said.
Boise Cascade Office Products distributes office products and has operations in Australia, Canada, Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
